items.title: Unified Semantic Layer and Data Harness for AI with Zetaris (full 2-hour course)
items.author: Andreas Kretz
items.summary:
Most AI projects inside a company don't get stuck on the model. They get stuck on the data. It's spread over several systems, nobody agrees on what revenue means, and security won't let an AI tool anywhere near production.

In this free course, I show you how to fix that with Zetaris. We deploy Zetaris Cloud into our own AWS account, connect three sources (Postgres, S3 and Databricks) without copying a single row, and build a unified semantic layer on top: business names, descriptions, data quality rules and access control in one place. Then we put the same layer into Tableau and connect Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Google Antigravity to it, and ask all of them the same business question.

Everything we do is also written down in the GitHub repository for this course: the dataset, every step and every command. So you can follow along at your own pace or look something up when you get stuck.

▶️ GitHub repository for this course: https://go.learndataengineering.com/sjndbauw
▶️  Start with Zetaris for free: https://go.learndataengineering.com/77pgmscr

🎁 Giveaway: win 1 of 10 memberships to my Data Engineering Academy! Answer a few questions about the course until November 22nd. Everything you need is in the course video. 
▶️ Quiz link: https://go.learndataengineering.com/a34ffxvk
